body:
QA run record for selector `since:v18` of the 18.0 release sweep (plan B: Tier 1 + Tier 2, Tier 3 deferred). Run by the `checklist-test` skill following `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `5b14b7f3ad8e2e0786d228772f473d07b36b2477` (objectstack-ai/objectstack `main`), tree clean, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `pnpm build` 76/76 green
- console: `.objectui-sha` = `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, built with `pnpm objectui:build`; `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamp equals the pin (`pnpm check:console-sha` green), so `stale-console-bundle` is ruled out for every console observation
- app: `examples/app-showcase`, boot `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/db/BATCH/ITEM.db` (one file DB per item, own port per item in ranges 41100–41999, at most one server per runner at a time); seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) + showcase seed 132 rows; demo personas from `examples/app-showcase/src/security/demo-personas.ts`
- Tier 1: every framework file named in the items' `automated.ref`, one vitest invocation per owning package (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 FILES` inside the package; 33 packages, 254 files incl. one Playwright spec)
- date: 2026-10-19 (UTC), container Linux 4 vCPU / 16 GB; runner: one orchestrator + 9 runner subagents (default judgment tier) in parallel, plus independent RUNNER rule 7 verifiers
